THE LAMPLIGHTER'S ROUND

Dusk on Tallow Lane, and Nell Brindle is late. Two lamps to light before Constable Pike walks his round, one can of oil, and a jackdaw with opinions.

Loading the engine...

Play

You are Nell, the lamplighter. Pick a verb, then click a person or a prop; Nell walks over before she acts, and Look works from where she stands. Point before you click: what a click would act on lights up with its action, such as [Talk to Hobb], and the line above the verbs says it too. With Walk, point along the cobbles to find the places she can stand.

Streets

Two streets: Tallow Lane, with Hobb's chandlery and its oil cask, and Market Steps, where Constable Pike waits by the fountain. Walk through the archway at the lane's end to reach the market, and back past the foot of the steps to return. The window, the door, the archway, the fountain, and the lamps can all be clicked anywhere on them.

Pixel art

Every room, person, and prop here is pixel art drawn at 320 by 180 and shown four times larger. The art began as PNG files beside the game's script; the engine's own command line read them into the game when it was built, and people walk and idle in animation.

Walkthrough

Show the solution
  1. Talk to Hobb: a taper. (Help yourself to his oil first and he will tell you about it.)
  2. Use the Oil Cask to fill the can, then use the Lane Lamp.
  3. Use the Oil Cask again; one fill lights one lamp.
  4. Walk through the Archway to Market Steps and try the Steps Lamp: Mrs Jessop the jackdaw is nesting in it.
  5. Talk to Pike about her, then go back to Hobb for something shiny.
  6. Use the Steps Lamp to offer Mrs Jessop the thimble, then use it again to light it.

Keys

  • Enter, Space, or a click: next message
  • S: play the next step for you
  • Right-click: next verb
  • I: state inspector (the facts as a graph; the game pauses)
Runs entirely in your browser on the BeSpoke Engine, a simulation engine for systemic and narrative games. The whole game is in this one file; nothing is downloaded or tracked.
